items.title: Notifications
items.name: Name
items.resetConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset the cycle? The new expiry date will be calculated from today.
items.renewConfirm: Are you sure you want to renew? The new expiry date will be one period after the current expiry date.

mode.label: Mode
mode.tooltip:
Cycle: add period from old expiry date (e.g. domains, memberships)
Reset: start new period from today (e.g. gym cards, parking cards)

items.kindRegularTooltip: General reminders without amount or currency, e.g. birthdays, anniversaries, etc.
items.kindSubscriptionTooltip: Membership expiration reminders that require periodic payment, e.g. streaming, VPS, domain names, etc.
items.notificationHoursHint: Leave empty to use global notification hours
items.typeTooltip: Describe the specific area, e.g.: Video membership / VPS / Domain / Gym card / Insurance, etc.
items.categoryTooltip: Describe the nature, e.g.: Personal / Work / Life / Entertainment
items.emptyDesc: Add your first subscription or reminder to start your ledger of time.

channels.feishuHint: Supports both Feishu Bot and Lark Bot
channels.noChannelsEnabled: No channels enabled, please configure in Channel Management first
channels.notificationHoursHint: Notifications are sent at most once per hour. Leave empty to allow every hour.
channels.smtpPasswordHint: Leave empty or keep the placeholder to retain the saved password.
channels.emailSmtpHint: Notification emails are sent through your own SMTP server, independently of the system email settings under Settings → Email Service. Port 465 uses SSL, other ports use STARTTLS.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.userDescription: Export your own eNotify data as a single JSON file, or restore / merge your own data from an export file.
backup.instanceDescription: Export the whole instance as a single JSON file, or restore the entire instance from an export file (disaster recovery) / merge your own data.
backup.exportDescription: Pack the data into one JSON file and download it. Encrypted export is on by default.
backup.encryptDescription: Protects the file with a passphrase (WebCrypto AES-GCM-256 + PBKDF2). Without the passphrase a leaked file cannot be read.
backup.passphraseHint: The passphrase is not stored and never logged. Keep it safe — a forgotten passphrase means the file cannot be restored.
backup.passphraseRequired: A passphrase is required when encryption is on
backup.passphraseTooShort: The passphrase needs at least {{min}} characters
backup.passphraseMismatch: The two passphrases do not match
backup.includeHistoryDescription: Notification history is a delivery log and is excluded by default. Enable it only if you need the past delivery records.
backup.exportSuccessEncrypted: Encrypted file {{filename}} downloaded — keep it with its passphrase.
backup.exportSuccessPlain: Plain-text file {{filename}} downloaded — it contains every credential, store it safely right away.
backup.masterKeyWarning: This file contains channel tokens, SMTP / mail passwords, TOTP secrets and every other credential — it is equivalent to a master key. Keep it offline and never send it over chat, email or a cloud link.
backup.apiKeyNotice: API keys are not part of the export (the server only stores hashes, so they cannot be exported). Re-issue them after a restore.
backup.importDescription: Pick an export file → preflight (writes nothing) → confirm → import.
backup.fileHint: eNotify JSON export files only, up to {{max}}.
backup.filePassphraseHint: Required for encrypted files — use the passphrase chosen at export time. It is only used for this request and is never stored.
backup.modeRestoreHint: Writes the whole file back into this instance and requires it to have no users yet — meant for disaster recovery.
backup.modeMergeHint: Merges only the personal data in the file into your own account: items and payments get new IDs and your channel config is overwritten by the file.
backup.modeFixedMerge: Personal imports are always a merge: only the rows that belong to you are merged into your account.
backup.reloginNotice: All users have to sign in again after an import.
backup.conflictTargetUsers: The target instance already has {{count}} user(s); restore mode requires an empty instance
backup.conflictConfigOverwritten: Your channel config will be overwritten row by row by the file
backup.conflictSettingsOverwritten: System settings that will be overwritten: {{keys}}
backup.conflictSkippedOrphan: Payments without a matching item will be skipped: {{count}}
backup.conflictSkippedForeignItems: Items belonging to other accounts will be ignored: {{count}}
backup.conflictSkippedForeignPayments: Payments belonging to other accounts will be ignored: {{count}}
backup.conflictSkippedHistory: Notification history rows will not be imported: {{count}}
backup.confirmRestoreMessage: The whole file will be written into this instance and this cannot be undone. Afterwards every user has to sign in again and API keys must be re-issued.
backup.confirmMergeMessage: Your personal data will be merged from the file: items and payments get new IDs and your channel config will be overwritten. This cannot be undone.

errors.passphraseRequired: This file is encrypted — enter the passphrase used at export time
errors.decryptFailed: Wrong passphrase or corrupted file. Nothing was written
errors.invalidFile: This is not a valid eNotify export file
errors.unsupportedVersion: The file format is newer than this server supports — upgrade eNotify first
errors.modeNotAllowed: This file cannot be used with the selected import mode
errors.mergeSourceNotFound: The file contains no data for your account, so it cannot be merged
errors.restoreTargetNotEmpty: This instance already has users, so restore mode is unavailable (no overwrite option)
errors.payloadTooLarge: The file exceeds the 10 MB limit
errors.stalePreview: The data changed after the preflight — run it again
errors.writeFailed: The write failed and the whole import was rolled back — nothing changed
errors.fileReadFailed: Could not read the file — is it a valid JSON export?
errors.sessionOnly: This action only works from a signed-in session, not with an API key
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that

blockerCodes.RESTORE_TARGET_NOT_EMPTY: The target instance is not empty; restore mode needs an instance with no users
blockerCodes.REFERENCE_MISSING: The file references rows that do not exist
blockerCodes.DUPLICATE_KEY: The file contains duplicate primary keys
blockerCodes.MISSING_COLUMN: File rows are missing required columns
blockerCodes.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT_VERSION: The file format is newer than this server supports
blockerCodes.MERGE_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The file contains no data for your account
blockerCodes.MODE_NOT_ALLOWED: This file cannot be used with the selected import mode
